Questions

Something else? Email us.

Can I switch plans later?+

Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated; downgrades apply at the end of your billing period.

What happens to my documents if I cancel?+

Nothing is deleted. You keep read and export access forever, and the Free plan limits apply to new documents.

Do you offer discounts for students?+

Students and teachers get Writer free for as long as they're enrolled. Verify with a school email in Settings.

Is my writing private?+

Documents are encrypted at rest and in transit. We never train models on your writing or sell your data.

Which payment methods do you accept?+

All major cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal. Annual Studio plans can also be paid by invoice.

Do you offer refunds?+

If you're not happy within 30 days of paying, email us and we'll refund you in full — no questions asked.
